core.title: Sartre Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull, Acorn PMH-M-06

text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-M-06, Sartre Stainless Steel Pull

The unique silhouette of Acorn's Sartre Stainless Steel Pull makes it a breath of fresh air in a crowded "modern style" hardware market. The pointed, tapered ends and the twisting curve of this cabinet pull has a gracefulness that many other pulls seem to lack. It has a brushed stainless steel finish. It comes packaged with screws for 4 inch center to center mounting.

Also Available Matching Sartre Cabinet Knob

Specifications of the Sartre Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Center to Center: 4"
  • Overall Length: 5-1/2"
  • Height: 1-1/8"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
